blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines, 20 October 2026 – Mynt, Inc. (“Mynt”), the parent company of the group behind GCash, the Philippines’ number one finance super app, today began trading on the Main Board of the Philippine Stock Exchange (“PSE”) under the ticker GCASH, marking its transition into a public company and a landmark moment for Philippine digital finance and capital markets. His Excellency President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. joined Ayala Corporation Chairman, Jaime Augusto Zobel de Ayala; Ayala Corporation President and CEO, Cezar Consing; Mynt Chairman, Ernest Cu; Mynt President and CEO, Martha Sazon; PSE President and CEO, Ramon S.
